$comment: M7 brief supplement to the section 7 fixture novel, as A39 cut it. The base fixture has few moments, no open questions or place communities, so SB-2 step 1's moments and steps 4 and 9 would select little from it. Brief selection tests load the fixture, apply these patches, and add these entries. The moments are the plot beats this file held before A39, as migration 9 makes them (B8 and B9 had no point of view, so they made none). Written by hand; never generated.

moments.title: Peter writes the letter
moments.body: Peter names the half-brother in a letter he never sends.

moments.title: Margaret hides the letter
moments.body: After the funeral Margaret puts the letter in her box.

moments.title: Ruth reads the letter
moments.body: Margaret gives Ruth the letter before she dies.

moments.title: Iris finds the letter
moments.body: Iris finds an envelope in the attic.

moments.title: Iris confronts Daniel
moments.body: Years later Iris asks her father outright.

moments.title: Lan visits Guangzhou
moments.body: Lan shows Iris the street where she grew up.

moments.title: Lan keeps the letters
moments.body: Lan moves her mother's letters into a locked drawer.

openQuestions.title: Does Daniel know about the uncle?
openQuestions.question: Has Daniel heard of the half-brother by 2045?

openQuestions.title: How cheap are grid batteries?
openQuestions.question: Can a household afford one in the forties?
